# Dhinovatech

> Dhinovatech makes privacy-first apps for Windows (Microsoft Store) and Android (Google Play). Most of them run entirely on the user's device, with on-device AI and no account.

## Apps

- [Smart Photos](https://www.dhinovatech.com/smart-photos/): Free AI photo organizer for Windows 10 and 11. Search photos in your own words, faces grouped, places map, Memories and duplicate clean-up, all on the PC with no setup, no account and no cloud. A private alternative to Google Photos.
- [KeepOne](https://www.dhinovatech.com/KeepOne/): Duplicate photo and file finder for Windows 10 and 11. Finds exact duplicates (confirmed byte for byte), similar photos, duplicate videos and duplicate folders; removed files go to the Recycle Bin and any of the last 20 cleanups can be undone. Free download, no account, no ads.
- [Steptell](https://www.dhinovatech.com/steptell/): Steps recorder and how-to guide maker for Windows 10 and 11, the modern replacement for Windows Steps Recorder (psr.exe). Records every click as a numbered step with a screenshot, then annotates, blurs personal information and exports to Word, PDF, PowerPoint, HTML, Markdown, video or SCORM. All features free, offline, no account.
- [Stow](https://www.dhinovatech.com/stow/): Offline AI photo and file organizer and duplicate finder for Windows.
- [Nudge](https://www.dhinovatech.com/nudge/): Offline journal and diary for Windows with an on-device AI companion; entries are plain Markdown files.
- [GlowCompare for Windows](https://www.dhinovatech.com/glowcompare-windows/): Skincare tracker with AI progress analysis, for Windows.
- [GlowCompare](https://www.dhinovatech.com/glowcompare/): Skincare routine and visual progress tracker for Android.
- [AES Vault](https://www.dhinovatech.com/aes-vault/): Lock files and folders on Windows with AES-256-GCM encryption, offline.
- [Notelock](https://www.dhinovatech.com/notelock/): Password-protected, encrypted notepad for Windows.
- [Mortgage Loan EMI Pro Insights](https://www.dhinovatech.com/mortgage-loan-emi-pro/): Free mortgage, EMI and loan calculator for Windows 10 and 11. Payment, full amortization schedule, extra payments, charts, comparing 3 loans and 12 decision tools such as rent or buy and refinance, offline with no account and no ads. Pro (one-time) adds real-loan tracking and advanced reports.
- [Milk Monthly Expense Calendar](https://www.dhinovatech.com/milk-monthly-expense-calendar/): Milk delivery diary and bill tracker for Android, in 12+ Indian languages.
- [Slouch Guard](https://www.dhinovatech.com/slouch-guard/): Real-time posture reminder.

## Smart Photos: key facts

- What it is: a free photo organizer for Windows 10 (version 2004 or later) and Windows 11, x64 and ARM64, made by Dhinovatech and sold in the Microsoft Store (ID 9N1J0MC0V89G).
- Price: free. The free version includes every feature and 30 searches a month (only typed searches count; they refill on the 1st). Smart Photos Pro is an optional one-time in-app purchase that unlocks unlimited searches. No subscription, no ads.
- Setup: install from the Microsoft Store and pick your photo folders. No account, no server, no Docker, no database. Browsing works right away; the AI models (about 1.8 GB) download once inside the app.
- Privacy: all AI runs on the PC. Photos, faces and searches are never uploaded; no telemetry; works offline. Original files are never modified.
- Features: search in your own words, face grouping, places map, Memories, text in photos (OCR), duplicate and blurry photo clean-up, albums, Windows Hello-locked hidden photos, RAW/HEIC/AVIF/JXL and most video formats.
- Imports: Google Takeout and iCloud Photos exports with their dates, albums and favorites; Picasa, Lightroom, digiKam and Windows Photo Gallery face tags.
- Requirements: 8 GB RAM (16 GB recommended). No Copilot+ PC or graphics card needed; uses a GPU or NPU when present.
- Languages: 25, and search works in each of them.
- Compared with others: Microsoft Photos searches in your own words only on Copilot+ PCs and groups faces only in Photos Legacy; Immich and PhotoPrism need a Docker server (Docker Desktop or WSL 2 on Windows); digiKam needs a database and named examples before it recognizes faces; Google Photos stores the library in Google's cloud and needs a Google Account.
- Pages: [overview](https://www.dhinovatech.com/smart-photos/), [privacy policy](https://www.dhinovatech.com/smart-photos/privacy.html), [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9N1J0MC0V89G)

## KeepOne: key facts

- What it is: a duplicate photo and file finder for Windows 10 (version 2004 or later) and Windows 11, x64 and ARM64, made by Dhinovatech and sold in the Microsoft Store (ID 9PP2PKFG978L).
- Finds: exact duplicates of any file type, similar photos (resized, re-compressed, edited, rotated; three strictness levels), duplicate videos (including same-length, same-content copies that are not byte-identical) and duplicate folders (a copied folder is one decision).
- Safety: exact matches are confirmed byte for byte, never by name or size alone; every group keeps at least one copy; removed files go to the Recycle Bin, or to KeepOne's own quarantine folder when the bin cannot take them; any of the last 20 cleanups can be undone; each file is re-checked right before it moves; Windows and program folders are never touched; cloud-only (OneDrive files-on-demand) files are never opened.
- Similar photos and fuzzy video matches are never selected automatically; only exact copies of the kept file are.
- Price: free download. Scanning, results, side-by-side review, history and undo are never limited. The free version removes up to 100 files or 1 GB in total; one in-app purchase removes the limit. No subscription.
- Privacy: no account, no sign-in, no ads, no telemetry, and no network connections of its own.
- Languages: 23, including Arabic and Hebrew.
- Pages: [overview](https://www.dhinovatech.com/KeepOne/), [privacy policy](https://www.dhinovatech.com/KeepOne/privacy.html), [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PP2PKFG978L)

## Steptell: key facts

- What it is: a steps recorder and how-to guide maker for Windows 10 22H2 and Windows 11, x64 and ARM64, made by Dhinovatech and sold in the Microsoft Store (ID 9MWWT8XPVF5K).
- Replaces Windows Steps Recorder (psr.exe), which Microsoft has deprecated (no longer updated, to be removed in a future Windows release). Opens Steps Recorder ZIP and MHT files as editable guides.
- Records: every click, shortcut, scroll and drag as a numbered step with a screenshot and a sentence such as "Click Save in Notepad", written in any of 25 languages per guide (independent of the app language).
- Edits: reorder, merge and split steps; arrows, boxes, callouts, numbered badges, spotlight, magnifier, crop and zoom; sections, tips and warnings; cover page, revision history and approvers; bug-report fields.
- Exports: Word, PDF, PowerPoint, HTML, Markdown, PNG/JPEG, animated GIF, MP4 video (zoom to each click, optional narration), SCORM, XLIFF, JSON, a Steps Recorder-style ZIP and the open .steptell format; one guide in several languages at once.
- Problem reports: "Report a problem" records, reviews and saves one ZIP for IT with steps, screenshots, system details, an optional ticket number and optional Windows error events.
- Privacy: keystrokes are never recorded (only shortcuts such as Ctrl + S); password boxes are blurred automatically; emails, phone and card numbers, IBANs and IP addresses are found in screenshots for one-click blur; excluded apps are never captured; library encrypted with AES-256; no account, no ads, no telemetry, no network connections of its own; no hidden recording mode.
- Price: every feature is free with no time limit. Free exports carry a small "Created with Steptell" label on images; Steptell Pro (one-time in-app purchase) removes it or replaces it with your logo, and a 24-hour pass does the same for a day. No subscription.
- IT: a link or command line starts a recording with ticket number and save folder; ADMX policies for Group Policy and Intune; works without internet or administrator rights.
- Pages: [overview](https://www.dhinovatech.com/steptell/), [privacy policy](https://www.dhinovatech.com/steptell/privacy.html), [support](https://www.dhinovatech.com/steptell/support.html), [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9MWWT8XPVF5K)

## Mortgage Loan EMI Pro Insights: key facts

- What it is: a mortgage, EMI and loan calculator for Windows 10 (version 1809 or later) and Windows 11, x86, x64 and ARM64, made by Dhinovatech and sold in the Microsoft Store (ID 9PFS2J56BJXR). Version 3 was rebuilt as a free native app with a Pro add-on.
- Price: everything you can calculate is free, with no account, no ads and no limit on use. Pro is an optional one-time in-app purchase, not a subscription. People who bought the app while it had a price keep the Pro features.
- Free: mortgage, car and personal loan payment (EMI), total interest, APR and payoff date; full amortization schedule by month or year with CSV export; monthly, yearly and one-off extra payments with interest and time saved; charts saved as images; comparing 3 loans; 3 saved scenarios per loan type; a one-page PDF preview; inflation-adjusted cost in today's money; tax relief, fees and property costs.
- 12 decision tools: how much can I borrow, how long will it take, the real rate behind a quote, debt-free by a date, what can I afford, what if rates rise, should I refinance, prepay or invest, rent or buy, how much down payment, what if I sell, how often should I pay.
- Loan detail: floating and fixed-then-floating rates, interest-only periods, balloon payments, step-up and step-down EMIs, moratoriums, stage-by-stage payouts; monthly, biweekly, accelerated biweekly, weekly and quarterly payments; Canadian semi-annual compounding and actual-day interest.
- Pro: My Loans tracking with payment logs, payment reminders and a check against the bank statement; several loans with the payoff order that saves the most; co-borrower splits and a yearly tax summary; full PDF decision reports; Excel workbooks with live formulas; unlimited scenarios; lender offers ranked against the current loan.
- Privacy: figures stay on the PC. No account, no ads, no telemetry, nothing uploaded, every calculation works offline; the only network use is the Microsoft Store licence check.
- Languages: 23 languages and 28 currencies, with lakh and crore or million grouping.
- Results are estimates for planning, not financial advice.
- Pages: [overview](https://www.dhinovatech.com/mortgage-loan-emi-pro/), [privacy policy](https://www.dhinovatech.com/mortgage-loan-emi-pro/privacy.html), [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PFS2J56BJXR)
